summary: INI inventory examples showing inline vs :vars typing, child groups, host vars overriding group vars, quoting secrets, child group vars overriding parents, all:vars, ungrouped hosts, same IP with different ports, and a host in multiple groups.
questions: How do I quote a password containing # in INI inventory?
Do child group vars override parent group vars?
Can two inventory hosts share the same IP with different ports?
Can a host be in two groups in INI inventory?
How do I set variables for all hosts in INI inventory?

answer_card.title: INI inventory examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[web]
host1
host2 ansible_port=222      # inline: integer

[web:vars]
http_port=8080
myvar=23                    # :vars: string

[web:children]
apache
nginx

[apache]
tomcat1
tomcat2 myvar=34            # host vars override group vars
tomcat3 mysecret="'03#pa33w0rd'"   # quote to keep value intact

[nginx:vars]
has_java = True             # child group overrides parent

[all:vars]
has_java = False

host2 ansible_host=127.0.0.1 ansible_port=44   # same IP, different ports
host3 ansible_host=127.0.0.1 ansible_port=45

[g1]
host4
[g2]
host4                       # in two groups, inherits both
```
